levelUnit: dBFS, 20*log10(PCM16 RMS/32768); fixture values rounded to 9 decimals
window: otherWindowRmsDbfs is each other track RMS over [startMs - 600, endMs], clipped to available PCM
expectedPolicy: Hand-authored; true means retain the timed word with echo:true, omit from display and metrics
sandwich: Nearest direct-echo anchors on the same microphone track; after.startMs - before.endMs < 1000; no recursive anchors
